title: Ordinary derived realization of coefficient towers in the section model
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its valuation ring [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $T$. Use the coefficient towers and their abelian and derived evaluation data $D$ of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Let $b$ be the section-normalized system presentation data of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], so its ordinary additive equivalence $b_T:\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E)\simeq\mathscr S_T$ preserves sections, restrictions and transition maps. Define the ordinary derived realization equivalence $\operatorname{Real}_{b,T,D}:D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))\simeq D(\mathscr S_T)$ to be the equivalence induced by applying $b_T$ termwise to complexes and localizing at quasi-isomorphisms. It is the ordinary derived equivalence, not an equivalence of diagrams of derived objects. This definition asserts no constructibility, boundedness, normalization or direct-image preservation theorem.
